d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how Ghana’s energy sector secured a landmark $2 billion capital commitment after Parliament ratified extensions to offshore petroleum contracts for the Jubilee and TEN fields through December 2040. Announced by the Petroleum Commission in Sekondi, the long-term extensions aim to halt production declines, expand upstream infrastructure, and support new developments like the commercial Eban-Akoma discovery. Onshore, Ghana National Petroleum Corporation’s exploration arm is set to begin drilling in the Voltaian Basin between late 2026 and early 2027.…
